commitments.detail: An independent convener will be required, sole chairing by either existing co-chair will be prohibited, and facilitated joint sessions will be mandated as safeguard conditions for the merged ERG.
A written charter will be required for the merged ERG, and a formal review will be conducted after exactly 90 days.
Meetings will begin no later than 2:00 p.m., and recordings and asynchronous access will be provided for all merged ERG programming.
A separate opt-in vote by each existing ERG will be required, with approval from at least two-thirds of voting members in each group, before the merged program can launch.
